title: Problem Overview
content: Erdős Problem #177: Discrepancy of Arithmetic Progressions. Status: OPEN

title: Discrepancy
content: The discrepancy of f with respect to common difference d: the supremum of |∑ f(n)| over all finite APs with common difference d. sSup {k : ℕ | ∃ a n : ℕ, n ≥ 1 ∧ (apSum f a d n).natAbs = k}

title: H
content: h(d) = the minimum discrepancy achievable over all valid colorings. sInf {k : ℕ | ∃ f : Coloring, IsValidColoring f ∧ discrepancy f d = k}

title: Roth Lower Bound
content: **Lower bound**: h(d) ≫ √d. From Roth's discrepancy theorem: no coloring can have discrepancy smaller than c√d for arithmetic progressions of common difference d. ∃ c : ℝ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ d : ℕ, d ≥ 1 → (h d : ℝ) ≥ c * Real.sqrt d

title: Beck Upper Bound
content: **Beck's upper bound**: h(d) ≤ d^{8+ε}. For every ε > 0, there exists a coloring achieving this bound. ∀ ε : ℝ, ε > 0 → ∃ C : ℝ, C > 0 ∧ ∀ d : ℕ, d ≥ 1 → (h d : ℝ) ≤ C * (d : ℝ) ^ (8 + ε)

title: Factorial Bound
content: **Cantor-Erdős-Schreiber-Straus**: h(d) ≤ d! is achievable. The earliest quantitative bound. ∀ d : ℕ, d ≥ 1 → h d ≤ Nat.factorial d

title: Erdos 177
content: Known bounds: c√d ≤ h(d) ≤ C·d^{8+ε}. The exact order of growth remains unknown. ∃ c : ℝ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ d : ℕ, d ≥ 1 → (h d : ℝ) ≥ c * Real.sqrt d := roth_lower_bound
